text: City Council at its meetings on July 12, 13, 14 and 15, 2018, April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018 and July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018 accepted the recommendations set out in TE17.21 - Request for Direction Report - 1-7 Yonge Street - Official Plan Amendment and Zoning Amendment Applications, TE31.15 - 55 - 95 Lake Shore Boulevard East, 33-53 Freeland Street, and 2 and 15 Cooper Street - Official Plan Amendment and Zoning Amendment - Request for Direction Report and GM29.25 - Acquisition of a Portion of 55 Lake Shore Boulevard East. As a result the City entered a tri party Parkland Agreement with the respective owners to secure a one hectare park, to be located at the address municipally known as 55 Lake Shore Boulevard East, comprising on-site and off-site dedications and a City acquisition of land. City Council on March 29, 30 and 31, 2023, adopted the following: 1.
